description: A Vue.js composable hook for managing employee report configuration, including criteria, display fields, and serialization of report data.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFieldsByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves all display fields associated with a specific group ID.

methods.name: getUnusedDisplayFieldsByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves display fields in a group that are not yet used/selected.

methods.name: addCriterion
methods.description: Adds the current criterion to the list of selected criteria and initializes its field values.

methods.name: removeCriterion
methods.description: Removes a criterion from the selected list and deletes its associated field values.

methods.name: addDisplayField
methods.description: Adds a display field to the selected display fields, managing group selection.

methods.name: removeDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Removes a display field group and its associated display fields.

methods.name: removeDisplayField
methods.description: Removes a specific display field from a group, and removes the group if no fields remain.

methods.name: serializeBody
methods.description: Serializes the report model into a request payload for API submission.
